Method of Attack: Encrypts user files by locking them in password-protected archives using a 25-character random encryption key generated locally
Drops ransom note demanding Bitcoin payment
Attempts to erase free space on root partition (fails due to coding error)
Changes last modified date of encrypted files to February 13, 2010
Attack Vector: Torrent files advertising license crackers for Adobe Premiere Pro and Microsoft Office for Mac
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file named README!.txt containing Bitcoin address 1EZrvz1kL7SqfemkH3P1VMtomYZbfhznkb
Email address rihofoj@mailinator.com used for ransom communication
Encrypted files' last modified date set to February 13, 2010
Date of Discovery: Last week before article publication (exact date not specified)
